pages.text: $(bold)Flame Manipulation$(): a torrent of blazing heat that burns everything to ash.$(br2)$(bold)Forward$(): target something within your sight and $(bold)melt$() the $(bold)3×3$() area of blocks beneath it (bedrock excluded) into $(bold)scorching lava$():$(li)the pool of lava automatically reverts to the original blocks after 3 seconds$(li)targets inside the pool take cursed damage every 0.75 seconds (shared damage base × 25% per tick, applying staff amplification and cursed energy core material traits) and are set on fire$(li)casting cost follows the formula (1 - Affinity/100) × (10 + Output × 5)$(br2)$(bold)Reversal$(): press the technique's reversal key (F) to summon $(bold)5 self-destructing flame phantoms · Flame Feathers$().

$(bold)Flame Feathers (Reversal)$():$(li)cost = $(bold)ceil(M × 100)$() (M = 1 + (Output + Affinity/10)/10)$(li)their bodies shrink to $(bold)1/8$() the size of a vanilla phantom with only 1 health, beating their wings extremely fast$(li)after a 1-second wind-up, they $(bold)dive in staggered succession$() at full speed toward the locked enemy$(li)each impact triggers an explosion $(bold)equal to the Black Bird's self-destruct$(): center damage = (1 + Affinity/100) × (Output × 3 + 1) × 10, falling off linearly over a 3-block radius$(li)the explosion also sets the enemy on fire and ignites the 3×3 area beneath its feet (the flames go out after 3 seconds)$(br2)Flame Feathers are fragile — if they are shot down on the way in (they have 1 health), they never arrive; they shine best when paired with the Forward lava pool to trap the enemy before detonating.
